title: GDP per capita PPP by country
hook: GDP per capita PPP by country, 1990 to 2025.
setup: The full race, year by year — watch the rankings shift from 1990 to 2025.

sequence.text: 1990: United Arab Emirates bursts into the ranking at #1 with 88.5K USD.
2001: Qatar takes the lead with 92.3K USD.
2015: Luxembourg takes the lead with 107.9K USD.
2019: Denmark bursts into the ranking at #10 with 62.7K USD.

ending: United Arab Emirates starts first; Singapore ends first.
